visual_text: 37 in 100 had harm from medicines within 8 weeks
1,116 people aged 65 or over leaving five hospitals in southern England, 2013 to 2015.
Mostly side effects: diarrhoea, constipation, falls, bleeding
About 29 in 100 needed NHS care for it, mostly a GP visit
For 4 in 10 with harm, the link was rated only 'possible'
Doctors' predictions at discharge of harm needing healthcare showed no clear link with who needed it
Parekh et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 2018 (two papers)
alt_text: Icon array of 100 people, 37 hatched orange for harm from medicines within 8 weeks of leaving hospital and 63 grey for none recorded. Cohort: 1,116 people aged 65 or over, five English hospitals. About 29 in 100 needed NHS care, about 8 in 100 were readmitted. Doctors' predictions at discharge showed no clear link with who was harmed.
